decisionsTitle: Arrows on the backoffice's tab bars when their tabs do not fit
decisionsSection:
The owner, 2026-10-11, looking at the section bar on a laptop, eleven tabs with the twelfth cut off at the right edge: the bar needs arrows in case it does not fit all. `AdminTabs` scrolled but set `scrollButtons={false}`, so nothing said that sections hid past the edge.

**Decision.** `AdminTabs` and the editor's language tabs (`LocaleTabPanels`) use `scrollButtons="auto"` with `allowScrollButtonsMobile`: MUI draws the arrows only while the tabs overflow, on a phone as well, and draws none when everything fits. Each arrow is 44 pixels wide (BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6). The preview's two-tab bar does not scroll and is unchanged.

**Refused.** A wrapper component around `Tabs` (`AGENTS.md` §1.3), and arrows hand-drawn beside the bar: MUI already measures the overflow and disables an arrow at its end.
changelogLine: - **Arrows on the backoffice's tab bars when their tabs do not fit** — the section bar and the editors' language tabs show scroll arrows (44 px) only while they overflow, on a phone too. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A backoffice tab bar whose tabs overflow shows scroll arrows, on a phone too, each a 44-pixel target, and shows none when the tabs fit (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
